help.main: Operate a Superstep instance from the command line.
help.version: Print the CLI version and, with --url, the server version.
help.json: Print one JSON object on stdout.
help.url: Base URL of the Superstep server.
version.warning_missing: The server did not report a version.
version.warning_mismatch: The CLI is {cli} and the server is {server}.
error.connection: Could not reach the server at {url}.
error.bad_response: The server at {url} did not return a health envelope.
help.install: Create an instance and start it.
help.adopt: Record an existing Compose directory as an instance.
help.start: Start the instance and wait until it is healthy.
help.restart: Restart the instance and wait until it is healthy.
help.yes: Do not prompt. Require --url and --admin-email, or an answers file.
help.answers: JSON file of answers for install.
help.name: Instance name. The default is superstep.
help.port: Host port. The default is 8000 for single and 8080 for full.
help.images: Load this image tar instead of pulling.
help.sandbox: Add the Code-node sandbox. Only with full.
help.adopt_flag: Adopt this Compose directory instead of creating an instance.
error.sandbox_topology: --sandbox is only valid with the full topology.
error.required: Pass --url and --admin-email, or an answers file.
error.health: The instance did not become healthy at {url}.
warn.memory: This host has under 1 GiB of memory.
warn.disk: This host has under 2 GiB of free disk.
help.status: Show version, service health, disk, and whether a newer release exists.
help.doctor: Report concrete problems with this installation.
help.show_secrets: Print secret values. Without this flag they are masked.
doctor.jwt: JWT_SECRET is missing or still the placeholder.
doctor.secret_key: STUDIO_SECRET_KEY is missing and no backup records it.
doctor.url: The public URL is not https.
doctor.proxies: STUDIO_TRUSTED_PROXIES is not set on the full topology.
doctor.socket: The Docker socket is not mounted for sandboxed code nodes.
doctor.clock: The API container clock is {seconds} seconds off.
doctor.provider: The provider at {url} did not answer.
doctor.offline: Provider check skipped because the network is offline.
config.restarted: Restarted the instance so {setting} takes effect.
config.kept: Wrote {setting}. A restart was not required.
error.config_args: config get needs a key. config set needs a key and a value.
help.backup: Write a backup archive, or install a backup schedule.
help.restore: Restore an instance from a backup archive.
help.to: Directory for the archive. The default is the instance directory.
help.schedule: Install a daily or weekly backup.
help.keep: How many archives the schedule keeps.
help.confirm_yes: Skip the name prompt. Requires --name equal to the instance name.
schedule.systemd: Installed a {period} backup timer. Keeping {keep} archives.
schedule.cron: Installed a {period} cron backup. Keeping {keep} archives.
error.disk: There is not enough free disk for this backup.
error.format: This CLI cannot read backup format {format}.
error.newer: The backup is from server {server} and the CLI is {cli}.
error.confirm_name: Type the instance name to restore. With --yes, pass a matching --name.
error.schedule: Pass --schedule daily or weekly together with --keep.
error.archive: The archive could not be read.
help.upgrade: Move an instance to a pinned version, with a backup and automatic rollback.
help.to_version: Version to install. The default is this CLI's version.
help.check: Report whether the target differs. Do not pull, back up, or restart.
upgrade.changelog_missing: The bundled changelog has no entry for this range.
error.downgrade: Target {target} is older than the running version {current}.
error.rolled_back: The upgrade failed and the previous version was restored. Log: {log}.
error.rollback_failed: The upgrade failed and restoring the previous version failed too. The instance may be incomplete. Log: {log}.
help.admin: Create an admin, reset a password, or list admins when nobody can sign in.
help.admin_create: Create an admin, or promote and reset the password when the email already exists.
help.admin_reset: Set a new password on an account.
help.admin_list: Print the email and role of each admin.
help.admin_password: Prompt for a password. It is not put on the command line. Omit it and the server generates one.
help.admin_password_stdin: Read the password from stdin, one line. It is not put on the command line.
error.admin_password_empty: Type a password, or omit --password and let the server generate one.
help.uninstall: Stop the instance and keep its volumes.
help.purge: Also remove the volumes and the instance directory. Requires the instance name.
uninstall.kept: Stopped {name}. The volumes and the instance directory are still there.
uninstall.purged: Removed {name}, its volumes, and the instance directory.
prompt.uninstall: Type {name} to remove the instance and its volumes
error.uninstall_name: Type the instance name to remove it. With --yes, pass a matching --name.
error.admin_output: The admin command did not return a usable result.
help.deploy: Install or upgrade an instance on a remote Docker host.
help.deploy_target: SSH URL of the Docker host, such as ssh://user@host.
help.force_upgrade: Upgrade an existing remote instance. Fail when it is absent.
example.deploy: Example: superstep deploy ssh://user@host --yes --url http://localhost:8000 --admin-email you@example.com
error.no_remote: There is no instance on this host, so --upgrade cannot run.
help.login: Sign in with a browser and store a personal access token.
help.logout: Remove the saved token from this machine.
help.token_name: Name of the personal access token.
help.no_browser: Do not open a browser. Print the approval URL instead.
logout.done: Signed out on this machine. Revoke the token in Settings to cancel it.
error.login_required: This command needs a token. Run superstep login.
error.denied: The sign-in was denied. Run superstep login again.
error.expired: The sign-in code expired. Run superstep login again.
error.device: The sign-in code is not valid. Run superstep login again.
error.server_old: The server {version} does not support this command.
help.workflows_list: List the workflows you can open.
help.workflows_export: Write one workflow to a file.
help.workflows_import: Create or update a workflow from a JSON file.
help.pull: Write every visible workflow into a folder.
help.push: Update the studio from a folder of workflow files.
help.format: Export format: json, python, typescript, or langgraph.
help.output: File to write. The default is the workflow id plus an extension in the current directory.
help.force: Overwrite studio edits and ignore the lock URL.
example.workflows_export: Example: superstep workflows export demo --format json
error.workflow_changed: {name} changed on the server since the last pull. Pass --force to overwrite it.
error.wrong_server: This folder was pulled from {lock_url}, not {url}.
error.ambiguous: More than one workflow is named {name}. Pass the id.
error.not_a_workflow: {file} is not a workflow JSON file.
help.run: Start a workflow and wait until it finishes.
help.runs_list: List waiting runs, or one workflow's history.
help.input: JSON input file. Use - to read stdin. The default is {{}}.
help.run_follow: Print each run event on stderr.
help.timeout: Seconds to wait before cancelling. The default is 300.
help.runs_workflow: Workflow id or exact name. Without it, list waiting runs.
error.workflow_not_found: No workflow has that id or name.
error.input: Input must be one JSON object.
help.test: Run a workflow's test suite and write JUnit XML.
help.mock: Run LLM nodes with the offline mock.
help.junit: JUnit XML path. The default is ./superstep-junit.xml.
help.all: Run every workflow that has at least one test.
test.timeout: Suite {name} was still running after {seconds} seconds.
error.workflow_forbidden: You cannot run tests on this workflow.
error.suite_running: The tests of this workflow are already running.
help.suite_timeout: Seconds to wait for the suite. The default is 300.
help.mcp: Serve the named workflows as MCP tools. This process speaks MCP on stdio.
error.mcp_disabled: MCP is off for {name}, or you cannot open it.
help.include_attachments: Also copy chat attachments kept in an S3 bucket into the archive. Files on a folder are always included.
help.restore_force: Restore even when the archive used another attachment storage; this instance keeps its own attachment settings.
error.storage_mismatch: The archive keeps chat attachments on {archived}, but this instance is set up for {target}. Use --force to restore anyway, then run superstep attachments migrate --to {target}.
backup.bucket_not_included: Chat attachments stay in bucket {bucket} (prefix {prefix}) and are not in this archive. Back the bucket up on its own, or use --include-attachments.
help.attachments: Manage where chat attachment files are stored.
help.attachments_migrate: Move chat attachment files to another storage backend. Safe to run again after an interruption.
help.attachments_to: The backend to move files to: db, fs or s3. Set STUDIO_ATTACHMENT_STORAGE to the same value so new files go there too.
help.attachments_dry_run: Only count the files that would move.
help.attachments_batch: Files per batch (1 to 1000). The default is 100.
attachments.pending: {pending} files are still on another backend. Run the command again to retry them.
help.attachment_storage: Where chat attachment files are stored: db (the database, default), fs (a folder on the data volume) or s3 (an S3-compatible bucket).
help.s3_endpoint: S3 endpoint URL for R2, B2 or MinIO. Empty means AWS S3.
help.s3_access_key_id: S3 access key ID. Without keys the default AWS credential chain is used.
help.s3_secret_stdin: Read the S3 secret access key from stdin. With --yes, SUPERSTEP_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY also works.
prompt.attachment_storage_single: Where should chat attachments be stored? db (database, default) or fs (folder):
prompt.attachment_storage_full: Where should chat attachments be stored? db (database, default), fs (folder) or s3 (S3-compatible):
prompt.s3_endpoint: S3 endpoint URL (empty for AWS S3):
prompt.s3_access_key_id: S3 access key ID (empty for the default AWS credentials):
error.attachment_storage: Unknown attachment storage {value}. Use db, fs or s3.
error.s3_bucket: The s3 attachment storage needs a bucket (--s3-bucket).
error.s3_keys: Give both the S3 access key ID and the secret access key, or neither.
doctor.attachments_worker: Chat attachments: the worker has not reported on the attachment folder yet; check that api and worker share the /data volume.
doctor.attachments_unknown: Chat attachments: {backend} (the instance did not answer, so storage was not checked).
